<function name="PlayerHurt" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<description>Called when a player gets hurt.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="victim" type="Player">Victim</arg>
		<arg name="attacker" type="Entity">Attacker Entity</arg>
		<arg name="healthRemaining" type="number">Remaining Health</arg>
		<arg name="damageTaken" type="number">Damage Taken</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Show players attacker in Chat.</description>
	<code>
function GM:PlayerHurt(victim, attacker)
    if ( attacker:IsPlayer() ) then
        victim:ChatPrint("You were attacked by : " .. attacker:Nick())
    end
end
	</code>

</example>
